bubble.drink: Psst... time for a cup of water!
bubble.focus: Focus mode: {time} left. You've got this!
bubble.hello: Hi! It's {time}. Ready when you are.
bubble.setup: Tell me about you in the Water tab so I can plan your day.
hydration.banner.due: Time for a cup of water! {left} to go.
hydration.disclaimer: General wellness guidance, not medical advice. If you have a condition that affects fluids, follow your clinician's advice.
hydration.held: A cup is due. I'll remind you at your next break.
hydration.remindersOff: Reminders are off (change it in Settings).
hydration.tooMuch: That's plenty for today. Listen to your body and slow down.
hydration.why.base: Your body holds about {tbw} L of water, which sets a {ml} mL daily baseline.
hydration.why.clamped: Adjusted into the safe range of 1.2 to 4.5 L.
hydration.why.total: Daily target: {ml} mL, about {cups} of {cup} mL.
hydration.why.weatherNone: No extra for the weather right now.
hydration.why.weatherUnknown: No weather data, so no weather adjustment.
keys.duplicate: Both shortcuts can't be the same.
keys.inWidget: In the widget: click the character to open it, Enter opens or closes it, Space start/pause, D log a cup, Z undo, 1-5 switch tabs, Esc show less.
keys.leftHint: Hidden → icon → menu. Works from any app; the tray icon does the same.
keys.listeningHint: Press the keys you want (Esc to cancel).
keys.rightHint: Menu → icon → hidden, then back to the menu.
keys.taken: That shortcut is already used by another app. Try a different one.
keys.warn.no-modifier: Without Ctrl/Cmd this key will stop working in every other app.
keys.warn.reserved: This combination is probably used by your system or other apps.
keys.warn.uses-space: Shortcuts with Space can clash with input-method switching.
keys.warn.weak-modifiers: Shift/Alt-only shortcuts may not work on macOS.
music.files.empty: Add a folder with your music, or drop a music pack into your extensions folder (see Settings > System).
music.files.licenseNote: Packs from your extensions folder play locally; only share music you have the rights to.
music.files.noTracks: No audio files were found here.
music.files.nothing: Choose a folder or pack to start
music.mutedHint: Everything is muted in Settings > Sound.
notify.break.body: Focus time: {min} minutes. You've got this!
notify.break.bodyManual: Start your next {min}-minute focus session when you're ready.
notify.break.title: Break's over!
notify.drink.body: {left} to go today. One cup is {cup} mL.
notify.drink.title: Time for a cup of water
notify.focus.body: Next up: {phase} ({min} min). Maybe grab some water?
notify.focus.bodyManual: Start your {phase} ({min} min) when you're ready.
notify.focus.title: Focus session done!
pomodoro.hint: Press Space to start or pause.
pomodoro.sessions: {done} of {total} focus sessions done in this set
profile.exerciseEstimate: About +{ml} mL of sweat to replace each day.
profile.intro: Height, weight, age and sex set your baseline. Exercise and weather add to it.
profile.sexNote: Used only for the body-water estimate. Stored on this computer.
profile.title: About you
settings.aboutText: Horologium {version}: a floating Pomodoro and hydration buddy. Entirely vibe coded; see AGENTS.md in the repository.
settings.followPomodoroHint: Plays while you focus and pauses on breaks.
settings.reduceMotionHint: Fewer animations and particles. Also follows your system setting.
settings.syncBreaksHint: Don't interrupt focus: a reminder waits (up to 20 minutes) until your break.
settings.updatesHint: Asks GitHub for the latest release at start-up and every 6 hours. Nothing about you is sent.
settings.userExtHint: Drop language files (locales/), your own stations (stations/) and music packs (music-packs/) here, then restart.
sound.checkHint: Plays two short notes and checks every step of the sound path.
sound.noDevice: No speakers found, so nothing can be heard. Install the PulseAudio client (sudo apt install libpulse0), then restart Horologium.
sound.noDeviceWsl: No speakers found: in WSL, Horologium needs the PulseAudio client to reach Windows. Run: sudo apt install libpulse0, then restart Horologium. (The Windows app needs nothing.)
sound.running: Checking... you should hear two short notes.
sound.stuck: Sound seems stuck. Try Settings > Sound > Sound check.
sound.tips: If the app's checks pass but you hear nothing, the problem is outside the app: check your system volume and the output device (headphones, speakers, Bluetooth).
sound.wsl: You're running Horologium inside WSL. WSL's audio bridge often crackles or drops out; the Windows app plays reliably.
status.waterDue: Water {done}/{total} cups, time for a cup!
update.downloadHint: Opens the release page. Install the new version over this one; your settings stay.
update.downloadHintMac: Opens the release page. macOS can't update an unsigned app by itself: download the new .dmg and drag Horologium to Applications again. Your settings stay.
update.error: Couldn't reach GitHub to check for updates.
update.installHint: Horologium downloads it, then restarts itself. Your settings stay.
update.notifyBody: Open News to see what's new and update.
update.off: Automatic update checks are off (Settings > System).
update.sourceAfter: Then quit and start the app again.
update.sourceHint: You run Horologium from its source code. In its folder, run:
weather.approxNote: Weather comes from Open-Meteo. "Approximate location" sends your IP address to ipwho.is once to guess your city.
weather.error: Couldn't reach the weather service. You can pick a climate manually.
weather.none: No location set, so no weather adjustment.
web.error: This page could not be loaded. Check your connection and try Reload.
